article.title: Esketamine-augmented stellate ganglion block improves postoperative sleep quality after gynecological laparoscopic surgery: a randomized controlled trial.
article.authors: Wang YL, Zhou L, Xu R
article.abstract: Postoperative sleep disturbance (PSD) is common after gynecological laparoscopic surgery and is associated with delayed recovery and adverse emotional outcomes. Stellate ganglion block (SGB) and esketamine have each been reported to modulate perioperative stress responses. We hypothesized that adding an esketamine-adjuvanted SGB to a perioperative multimodal sleep (PMS) strategy based on intraoperative esketamine and dexmedetomidine would reduce PSD.
